results.name: heldout-unanswerable-how-much-commission-did-bob-agent-earn-on-the-20-ff6480
failures: expected a refusal (question is out of scope / unanswerable), but the run answered with kind uncertified

proofs: executed on the warehouse: 1 row in 45 ms
answer.sql:
SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS commission
FROM acme_insurance.main.premium p
JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy_amount pa
  ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy pol
  ON pa.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.agreement_party_role apr
  ON pol.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.party pt
  ON apr.Party_Identifier = pt.Party_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
  AND LOWER(CAST(pt.Party_Name AS VARCHAR)) = LOWER('Bob Agent')
  AND pa.Earning_Begin_Date BETWEEN 20190101 AND 20191231
LIMIT 501

answer.sql:
SELECT
    ar.Assessment_Result_Type_Code AS underwriting_decision
FROM acme_insurance.main.policy p
JOIN acme_insurance.main.agreement_assessment aa
    ON aa.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.assessment_result ar
    ON ar.Assessment_Identifier = aa.Assessment_Identifier

WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000337
LIMIT 500

answer.sql:
SELECT
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS earned_premium
FROM acme_insurance.main.policy_amount pa
JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy p
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.premium prem
    ON prem.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336
  AND pa.Effective_Date >= DATE '2019-01-01'
  AND pa.Effective_Date < DATE '2020-01-01'
LIMIT 501

    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_industry_insured_loss
FROM acme_insurance.main.claim_amount ca
JOIN acme_insurance.main.loss_payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
JOIN acme_insurance.main.catastrophe cat
    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
WHERE LOWER(cat.Catastrophe_Name) LIKE '%fire%'
LIMIT 501
